caption:
Chicken Caesar’s Pasta Salad: Crisp, Crunchy, and Totally Guilt-Free! 🥗✨

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: (calculated on Myfitnesspal)
C: 50 | F: 10 | P: 45
Calories: 427 per portion 
Recipe makes 2 portions

Ingredients: 
2 chicken breast, slightly pounded,salt and pepper & cajun seasoning 
400 grams romaine lettuce, you can use a variety here as you prefer
80 grams pasta, uncooked
grated cheese

Caesar’s “cheats” Dressing
1 cup greek yogurt / 160 grams ish 
3-4 garlic cloves, minced
1 tbsp WC sauce*
1 tbsp mustard
1/2 tsp salt + 1/2 tsp pepper

*the best replacement for WC sauce if you dont have it / dont want to use it - 1 tablespoon ketchup + 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar + ½ tablespoon soy sauce + 1 dash hot sauce (optional)

Method: 
start by boiling your pasta and setting aside to cool
Pan fry your chicken breast, you can do this without any oil or 1/2 tsp oil as well
season with salt, pepper and cajon seasoning ( optional) but it tastes SO good
once done, set aside to cool and prepare the dressing 

to make the dressing, combine all the ingredients and place in the fridge

before you layer you ideally want all ingredients to be cool or cold to ensure its a nice cooling salad
layer the salad
shredded romaine - grilled chicken - croutons - cheese - dressing and voila, your salad is ready :)
